crossRefs.note: Yahweh will scatter you among the peoples, and you will be left few in number among the nations where Yahweh will lead…
You will be left few in number, even though you were as the stars of the sky for multitude, because you didn’t listen…
Unless Yahweh of Armies had left to us a very small remnant, we would have been as Sodom. We would have been like…
For though your people, Israel, are like the sand of the sea, only a remnant of them will return. A destruction is…
But I will leave a few men of them from the sword, from the famine, and from the pestilence, that they may declare all…
Isaiah cries concerning Israel, “If the number of the children of Israel are as the sand of the sea, it is the remnant…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: For the Lord Yahweh says: “The city that went out a thousand shall have a hundred left, and that which went out one hundred shall have ten left to the house of Israel.”
translations.bsb: This is what the Lord GOD says: “The city that marches out a thousand strong will have but a hundred left, and the one that marches out a hundred strong will have but ten left in the house of Israel.”
translations.kjv: For thus saith the Lord GOD; The city that went out by a thousand shall leave an hundred, and that which went forth by an hundred shall leave ten, to the house of Israel.
translations.asv: For thus saith the Lord Jehovah: The city that went forth a thousand shall have a hundred left, and that which went forth a hundred shall have ten left, to the house of Israel.
